theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.wtraceW_ne_of_level_ne (q : ℝ) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) {r s : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
(SeminormalRep.wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight r (q ^ 2)) 1) (Hecke.σ ℝ q q⁻¹ 1 (Fin.last 0)) ≠ (SeminormalRep.wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight s (q ^ 2)) 1) (Hecke.σ ℝ q q⁻¹ 1 (Fin.last 0))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.eq_wenzlWtrace_of_markov_real (q : ℝ) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (T : HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily ℝ q q⁻¹ ((q ^ 2) ^ r / (q * levelBracket r (q ^ 2)))) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke ℝ q q⁻¹ n) :
(T.tr n) x = (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight r (q ^ 2)) n) x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.realGen_of_sq_ne_one {q : ℝ} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (k : ℤ) :
k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.gen_of_notRootOfUnity {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {q : K} (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (k : ℤ) :
k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.level_unique_of_wenzlMarkovTrace_eq {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1) {r s : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : (SeminormalRep.wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight r (q ^ 2)) 1) (Hecke.σ K q q⁻¹ 1 (Fin.last 0)) = (SeminormalRep.wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight s (q ^ 2)) 1) (Hecke.σ K q q⁻¹ 1 (Fin.last 0))) :
r = s

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wenzlMarkovTrace_two_tr {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hq21 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke K q q⁻¹ n) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight 2 (q ^ 2)) n) x = (wtrace q hq0 hq2 n) x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.eq_wenzlWtrace_of_markov {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (T : HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily K q q⁻¹ ((q ^ 2) ^ r / (q * levelBracket r (q ^ 2)))) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke K q q⁻¹ n) :
(T.tr n) x = (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight r (q ^ 2)) n) x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wenzlMarkovTrace_tr {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
(wenzlMarkovTrace q hq0 hq2 hgen hr).tr = wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (wenzlWeight r (q ^ 2))

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wenzlMarkovTrace {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → (q ^ 2) ^ k ≠ 1) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily K q q⁻¹ ((q ^ 2) ^ r / (q * levelBracket r (q ^ 2)))

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.markovTraceOfWeight {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (z : K) (hnorm : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, ↑(Mathlib.numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν) * w ↑ν = 1) (hbranch : ∀ (ν : YoungDiagram), ∑ s : { s : ℕ × ℕ // Mathlib.IsAddableCell ν s }, w (Mathlib.addCellOrSelf ν ↑s) = w ν) (hmarkov : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m), ∑ L : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 }, w ↑L * ((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 (m + 1) ⋯) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) * genMat q (m + 1) ⋯ ⋯).trace = z * ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = m + 1 }, w ↑ν * ((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 m ⋯) y).trace) :
HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily K q q⁻¹ z

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_markov {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (z : K) (hmarkov : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m), ∑ L : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 }, w ↑L * ((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 (m + 1) ⋯) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) * genMat q (m + 1) ⋯ ⋯).trace = z * ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = m + 1 }, w ↑ν * ((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 m ⋯) y).trace) (m : ℕ) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w (m + 1)) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y * Hecke.σ K q q⁻¹ (m + 1) (Fin.last m)) = z * (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w m) y

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_incl {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (hbranch : ∀ (ν : YoungDiagram), ∑ s : { s : ℕ × ℕ // Mathlib.IsAddableCell ν s }, w (Mathlib.addCellOrSelf ν ↑s) = w ν) (m : ℕ) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w (m + 1)) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) = (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w m) y

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_one {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (hnorm : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, ↑(Mathlib.numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν) * w ↑ν = 1) (n : ℕ) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w n) 1 = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_cyclic {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (n : ℕ) (x y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ n) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w n) (x * y) = (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w n) (y * x)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_apply {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke K q q⁻¹ n) :
(wtraceW q hq0 hq2 w n) x = ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n + 1 }, w ↑ν * ((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 n ⋯) x).trace

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (w : YoungDiagram → K) (n : ℕ) :
Hecke K q q⁻¹ n →ₗ[K] K
